requirement.summary: Rewrite the English and Simplified Chinese artifact replay presentation pages as a chronological first-person engineering story using only recorded repository events. Lead with the verification question, the first PATH-free worker stop, the human-selected decision to keep the worker restricted and pass validated manifest facts, the second hidden driver dependency, the filesystem-only repair, and the sole successful 1/1/1 replay. Keep architecture, metrics, evidence taxonomy, hashes, hover and focus disclosures, and unknowns as supporting proof. Do not invent project origins, personal motivations, score experiments, or unrecorded failures. Add focused tests and closeout documentation. Validate locally only.
